high_level_description: This image depicts an astronaut performing an extravehicular activity (EVA), commonly known as a spacewalk, on the International Space Station (ISS). The astronaut is wearing a white spacesuit with various patches and equipment attached to it, including a helmet with a reflective visor. The suit also features a NASA logo on the left shoulder. The astronaut is positioned against the exterior of the ISS, which is covered with white thermal blankets and various components such as solar panels, antennas, and other hardware.
